post.description: Queue an existing recipient-bound signed authorization. Derives account and current wallet from verified identity; never accepts recipient, signature, or transaction data. Requires check-in, active claim window, unexpired authorization, matching live collection and available supply. A read-only collection gateway is sufficient; worker verifies issuer authorization before broadcast. Repeated submissions return the same job, including after expiry. A queued or included job does not grant collection ownership.

202.description: New or existing pending claim job

403.description: Account, current wallet or check-in required

409.description: Wallet/payload conflict, already owned, sold out, invalid claim, not yet open, or another pending claim

410.description: New submission authorization expired or claim window closed

503.description: Chain unavailable or deployment mapping invalid

get.description: Return only this account's job for the specified event. Available without RPC or issuer configuration. Does not return signatures, raw transactions, provider diagnostics, or private credentials. Status incorporates exact-transaction receipt observations when the read-only chain worker is configured. finality distinguishes unverified, included and finalized. chainOutcome distinguishes execution success, revert, pending or mismatch; finalized does not itself mean success or ownership. Ownership must still be read from the contract.
